title: Interaction with the Environment via Random Matrices and the Emergence of Classical Field Theory
summary: It was recently shown that Newtonian dynamics of macroscopic particles can be derived from unitary Schrödinger evolution under a random-matrix assumption on the system-environment interaction. In that framework, classical phase space is realized geometrically as a manifold of localized equivalence classes in quantum state space, the tangent component of Schrödinger evolution reproduces Newtonian motion, and environmental interactions stabilize the state near this manifold.
